methodology.runs: 20 seeds for each of six table types at 3, 5 and 8 farmers: 360 games total.
methodology.sellPromise: Always Sell and promise each round except the last.
methodology.sharePromise: Always Share and promise each round except the last.
methodology.random: Uniform random tap among currently available cards, with independent 50% contract toggle; no promises on the last round. Separate seeded decision stream preserves event comparability.
methodology.cooperative: Share normally; Store when a forecast warns of next-round flood (except the final round); Release in crises if stock exists, otherwise Share. Promise one unit for the next round whenever a next round remains.
methodology.mixed: Alternating selfish/cooperative seats, with the assignment rotated by seed; odd-size tables have one extra selfish farmer.
methodology.council: Automatic Council in every table: emergency-buy reserve to cover projected unmet need first, then pay for submitted hub deliveries; never override a farmer’s card. Transport and budget constrain actual delivery.
methodology.cash: Actual end-of-game cash, including early collective losses; only surviving farmers meeting their cash goal win.
methodology.waste: Spoiled harvest plus decay of farmer-owned stock; shared reserve never decays.
